activities.title: Arrive and settle
activities.description: Choose a comfortable place. Take as much time as you need.

activities.title: Explore a texture
activities.description: Choose an object to look at or touch. Watching is also an option.

activities.title: A quiet pause
activities.description: Rest, stretch, or sit quietly. There is no task to complete.

activities.title: Close together
activities.description: Choose how to finish: a word, a gesture, or a quiet goodbye.
